title: Flights on a date
statementMd:
List the ids of flights departing on 2024-03-15 or later but before 2024-03-20.

Expected columns: `id`, `depart_date`.

Tables: `airlines`, `airports`, `flights`, `bookings`.

Row order does not matter.
solutionMd:
```sql
SELECT id, depart_date FROM flights WHERE depart_date >= '2024-03-01' AND depart_date < '2024-03-20';
```

Compare with your own query; the result sets must match.
